scientific_integrity: Analytic conditional shell laws and one-shell rigidity proved using Minkowski uniqueness and facet-normal balance; examples checked with standalone floating-point diagnostics.
scientific_limitations: Population-level conditional distributions; no noisy-sampling stability theorem. Underlying inner-parallel homothety and scalar perimeter laws are prior work. Possible unlocated equivalent specialist result.
title: One-shell nearest-facet rigidity and a single-edge test for tangential quadrilaterals
